label: CCPA § 1798.120 — Right to opt out of sale or sharing
body: (a)(1) A consumer shall have the right, at any time, to direct a business that sells or shares personal information about the consumer to third parties not to sell or share the consumer's personal information.
(b) A business that sells or shares … shall provide notice to consumers … that this information may be sold or shared and that consumers have the "right to opt out" …

(c) A business shall not sell or share the personal information of consumers if the business has actual knowledge that the consumer is less than 16 years of age, unless: (i) the consumer, if 13–15, has affirmatively authorized; or (ii) the consumer's parent or guardian, if under 13, has affirmatively authorized. A business that willfully disregards the consumer's age shall be deemed to have had actual knowledge.
